best_idea: A death window that adds one step per death and reads the delay tier at reclaim time with the one-second boundary fixed; every route back from a ghost (own reclaim and another player's resurrect) passes the same gate.
decision_why: Keep the window and table as in cell 1, add the one-second boundary fix, and gate healer resurrect requests on the same delay (the donor does not); durability left out of v1.
acceptance: A ghost in an open zone at window tier 2 cannot accept a healer's resurrect before 120 s has passed, and a server test asserts that a lone death released in the same whole second shows 30 s, not 60 s.
